primaryMetric.name: verified_completion_rate
primaryMetric.definition: Successful completions divided by all scheduled runs, including failed runs, reported per task and arm and across the frozen suite.

regressionGate.rule: The apply arm fails the operational quality gate if it has two or more fewer successful completions than control on any task, or more than one fewer successful completion across all 50 runs.
regressionGate.statistics: This operational gate is not a statistical-equivalence test.

costClaimGate: Publish cost comparisons only when every scheduled run has complete monetary data and the regression gate passes. Use the cost of all attempts as numerator for cost per successful completion.
scheduleRule: Run each listed pair from a fresh copy of the same fixture and commit. Odd-numbered tasks begin control-first; even-numbered tasks begin apply-first. Alternate within each task. This yields 25 first positions per arm.
sharedInstructions: Work only in the current synthetic repository. Complete the task, use local tools as needed, and do not modify any file listed as protected. Do not access parent directories, user configuration, credentials, network services, or unrelated files. Finish with a concise result.

tasks.prompt: Fix parse.mjs so parseRows returns every non-empty CSV data row as an object keyed by the header. Preserve quoted commas. Do not change parse.test.mjs; finish only when its tests pass.

files.parse.mjs: export function parseRows(text) { const [header, ...rows] = text.trim().split('\n').map(line => line.split(',')); return rows.slice(0, -1).map(row => Object.fromEntries(header.map((key, index) => [key, row[index]]))); }
files.parse.test.mjs:
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import test from 'node:test'; import { parseRows } from './parse.mjs'; test('all rows and quoted commas', () => assert.deepEqual(parseRows('id,name
1,Ada
2,"Lovelace, Ada"
'), [{id:'1',name:'Ada'},{id:'2',name:'Lovelace, Ada'}]));

tasks.prompt: Fix rolling.mjs so movingAverage returns one average for every complete window and rejects window sizes below one or above the input length. Do not modify rolling.test.mjs.

files.rolling.mjs: export function movingAverage(values, size) { if (size < 1) throw new RangeError('size'); return values.slice(0, -size).map((_, i) => values.slice(i, i + size).reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0) / size); }
files.rolling.test.mjs: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import test from 'node:test'; import { movingAverage } from './rolling.mjs'; test('complete windows', () => assert.deepEqual(movingAverage([2,4,6,8],2),[3,5,7])); test('invalid sizes', () => { assert.throws(() => movingAverage([1],0), RangeError); assert.throws(() => movingAverage([1],2), RangeError); });
